title: MIHVER Publication Package Manifest
description: Machine-readable shape of the PublicationPackage manifest V3.1-B's unprivileged client (cmd/mihver-publish) produces alongside a self-contained Git bundle, and the privileged Publication Broker consumes as UNTRUSTED input (tools/publication-broker/internal/protocol.PackageManifest is the canonical Go implementation of this exact shape). The manifest binds the Envelope/Receipt/bundle digests the REQUEST DIGEST is computed over -- see docs/development/PUBLICATION_BROKER.md's 'PublicationPackage / Request Digest' section, which is the semantic owner of the recipe itself.

envelope_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact raw Envelope JSON bytes carried alongside this manifest.

receipt_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact raw Receipt JSON bytes carried alongside this manifest.

bundle_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact raw Git bundle bytes carried alongside this manifest.

commit_sha.description: The exact commit the bundle is claimed to carry; the Broker independently confirms this by resolving the bundle's fixed import ref after fetching it into broker-owned storage -- see internal/pkgimport.
